job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled NLP and LLM Engineer to join our growing team. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing cutting-edge natural language processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions that power our products and services. This role involves working with state-of-the-art models, data pipelines, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative AI-driven features.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy NLP and LLM-based solutions for various business applications.
Fine-tune, adapt, and optimize pre-trained LLMs for specific use cases.
Develop and maintain robust data pipelines for text data preprocessing, feature extraction, and model training.
Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and software engineers to integrate NLP/LLM capabilities into our products.
Research and implement the latest advancements in NLP and LLM technologies.
Evaluate model performance, identify areas for improvement, and iterate on solutions.
Write efficient, well-documented, and maintainable code.
Stay current with the rapidly evolving field of AI and machine learning.
Contribute to the overall architecture and strategy for AI/ML initiatives.
Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, AI, or a related quantitative field.
Proven experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and working with Large Language Models (LLMs).
Strong programming skills in Python and experience with NLP libraries (e.g., NLTK, spaCy, Hugging Face Transformers).
Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks and tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI API).
Experience with ML model development, training, and evaluation.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and associated ML services.
Experience with data processing and database querying (e.g., SQL).
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
Experience in deploying ML models into production environments is a plus.
Experience in the healthcare or insurance industry is a plus.
